I changed the copy constructor to use a member-initializer list, constructing each member directly from the source instead of default-constructing then copy-assigning. This avoids unnecessary vector assignment overhead while preserving identical behavior.

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(field.values),
      stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes)
{
}
```
